newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador sets date for midterm elections.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador sets date for midterm elections.

text.p: The Supreme Electoral Tribunal of El Salvador said on Friday the Central American country will hold midterm legislative and municipal elections on March 16, 1997.
Voters will pick 84 deputies for the Legislative Assembly and mayors and city councilors in 262 municipalities. The winners will serve three-year terms starting May 1, 1997.
El Salvador has 2.86 million people of voting age.
The next presidential elections are set for 1999.
